Analytics FAQs
What analytics do I get with a Pulse plan?

Every plan includes a full Marketing overview, Executive summary, revenue attribution, channel performance across Email, Push, and WhatsApp, deliverability quality, and automation analytics, from day one.
How is revenue attribution calculated?

Revenue is traced back to a specific campaign or automation once a tracked order is linked to a marketing touch. Until there's enough activity in a period, you'll see "Attribution unavailable" rather than a misleading number.
What are the industry benchmarks based on?

Delivery rate, open rate, click rate, unsubscribe rate, and spam complaint rate are each shown alongside a real industry average, so you can judge your own numbers against a genuine reference point, not just in isolation.
Can I customize what shows up on my report?
Yes. Use Customize report to turn sections like Revenue & attribution, Channel performance, or Automations on or off, so your report reflects what actually matters to you.
How does Pulse's AI fit into analytics?

Pulse's AI reviews your campaign data in the background and surfaces plain-language insights automatically, like which channel or flow is outperforming the rest, along with a specific suggested next move.
Can I export or schedule reports?
Yes. Use Export to download your data, or Schedule report to have it sent to you automatically on a recurring basis.
Does analytics work the same across Email, Push, and WhatsApp?

Each channel tracks the metrics that make sense for it. WhatsApp tracks Read since read receipts are part of the platform, for example, while all three are still comparable side by side in Channel performance.
